images.prompt: Create an original natural color photograph of one older woman seated upright on one low wooden stool in a modest pottery studio. She wears an indigo cotton shirt and cream trousers, both hands resting separately on her knees. Show her entire body and both shoes. A single plain clay bowl sits on a small rectangular worktable at image left, while one tall rectangular window at image right provides soft daylight. Pale plaster wall behind her, quiet attentive expression, realistic skin and fabric, balanced ordinary photographic contrast. Eye-level camera, woman centered slightly right, clear gaps between stool, table and shoes, uncropped objects. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. No lettering, labels, logos, watermark, frame or decorative border. This is a straightforward source photograph, without monochrome conversion or film effects.

images.prompt:
A full-frame silver gelatin darkroom enlargement with continuous photographic tones and restrained, irregular silver grain.
Preserve: Subject identity, age, expression and body proportions; Exact subject and object counts; Existing crop, camera perspective and spatial overlaps; Source light direction and recognizable material texture.
Render a silver gelatin enlargement; build the image from continuous photographic density, never drawn outlines or painted shading.
Use neutral charcoal, silver gray and soft paper white; separate nearby colors by luminance rather than arbitrary color tinting.
Retain the source light direction; gently dodge important midtones and burn bright distractions without creating local halos.
Introduce fine irregular silver grain across tonal areas, weaker in highlights and never coarse enough to erase skin or fabric.
Resolve contours through natural tonal transitions; keep facial edges, fingers and overlapping objects anatomically coherent.
Keep the original crop, perspective, subject scale and every foreground-to-background overlap unchanged.
Hold readable shadow detail and delicate highlight texture; preserve pores, fabric weave and existing material distinctions.
Finish as a clean photographic print filling the entire image; no paper border, sprocket holes, date stamp or simulated damage.
Use the supplied photograph as the sole composition reference; analyze its actual subjects. Keep the full frame and original aspect ratio, at least 1024x1280. Output only the finished image.
Avoid: sepia or selective color; crushed featureless shadows; chalky clipped skin; heavy uniform digital noise; ink outlines or charcoal drawing; film frame, paper margin or sprocket holes; new text, logos or watermark.
